summary: Make https://ekodi.kr/support the sole canonical and production Support user entry, remove support.ekodi.kr from EKODI legacy-domain registration, and align routing, identity, monitoring and deployment verification with the path-based service boundary.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly instructed EKODI to continue and change the Support domain standard to ekodi.kr/support. This also follows the previously established rule that retired EKODI subdomains are not kept as compatibility redirects.
evidence: Cloudflare Worker production route uses ekodi.kr/support*
service and capability registries use https://ekodi.kr/support
Support static assets and API calls are path-scoped under /support
central identity CORS uses the ekodi.kr origin
support.ekodi.kr removed from legacy allowlist and legacy target map
production verification probes the real ekodi.kr/support route
generationImpact: None. Generation 10 Benefit Radar remains active.
scaleImpact: None. This changes routing topology, not scale tier.
authorityImpact: None. Existing human gates, consent-first behavior and EKODIBIZ commercial-subject policy remain unchanged.
rollback: Revert the v1.13.0 routing amendment and path-scoped Support changes through the guarded release path. Do not silently recreate support.ekodi.kr; any future subdomain boundary would require separate governance approval.
